questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the option that correctly reports the following statement: 'I have already finished my homework,' he said to me.
options: He said to me that he had already finished his homework.
He said to me that he has already finished his homework.
He said to me that he would have finished his homework.
He said to me that he was finishing his homework.
questions.answer: He said to me that he had already finished his homework.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information?
options: It is said that the project has been completed.
It is said that the project was completed.
It is said that the project will be completed.
It is said that the project is being completed.
questions.answer: It is said that the project was completed.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct type of conditional: If I _____ more time, I _____ the trip to Spain last year.
Choose the best collocation: After the meeting, we need to _____ a decision on the budget.
Which of the following is the correct preposition to complete the phrase? 'He insisted _____ going to the party.'
Select the appropriate discourse marker to begin a sentence giving an unexpected opinion: _____, I think that proposal is actually quite good.
Which of these sentences uses the correct form of the verb after a modal verb?
options: She might have to work late.
She might have been working late.

questions.question: Choose the correct word to complete the idiom: Don't _____ your hand in the middle of the game.
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: I have been living here for five years.
I have lived here for five years.
I am living here for five years.
I lived here for five years.
questions.answer: I have been living here for five years.
